_note: The work queue consists of cases (Ruben, 24 Nov). In OpenRegister's Mail panel the case schema offers two blocks: Case, which finds any case and creates one through dossiq's own New case dialog, and Work queue, which lists the unassigned cases and puts a mail in the queue as a new unassigned case from the generic dialog. The intake log (mailIntakeEntry) is no longer offered in the panel. A fragment rather than an edit to dossiq_register.json, per ADR-037.
